note: The room sound and music under each chapter, made with ElevenLabs. Edit a prompt and push, and the GitHub Action makes just that one again. kind is sfx (up to 30 seconds, loops) or music. step is the reveal it starts on, so a chapter can change rooms partway through. level is how loud it sits under the narrator, from 0 to 1.

range.prompt: Wind across an empty two-lane highway at dusk, crickets, a distant truck passing, wide open country

origin.prompt: City sidewalk at night after rain, light drizzle, a heavy basement bar door opening below the street, muffled jukebox and voices from downstairs

anatomy.prompt: Quiet dive bar in the afternoon, the low hum of a beer cooler, faint buzz of an old neon sign, an occasional ice clink in a glass, a wall clock ticking

lineage.prompt: A 1930s rural juke joint on a hot Saturday night. Raw acoustic Delta blues with slide guitar and harmonica, stomping feet on a wooden floor, people clapping and whooping, a lively crowd. Recorded live in a small wooden room, warm and lo-fi.

A 1950s Texas honky-tonk dance hall. A rowdy two-step shuffle with fiddle, pedal steel guitar, twangy electric guitar, upright bass and brushed snare. Boots on a wooden dance floor, a loud happy crowd. Recorded live in the room.

sp1.prompt: Neighborhood bar on a weeknight, a ballgame murmuring on an old TV, pool balls clacking, relaxed conversation, glasses set down on a wooden bar

mcsorleys.prompt: Crowded old New York ale house, lively chatter, heavy glass mugs clinking together, footsteps on a sawdust floor, a bartender calling out light or dark

sp2.prompt: After-shift bar in an old industrial town, low tired conversation, a cash register drawer, a distant freight train horn, a slow country ballad on a jukebox far across the room

sp3.prompt: Ramshackle waterfront shack bar on a Florida key, wind, gulls, water lapping against wooden pilings, oysters sizzling on a burning barrel, a few people laughing

dollars.prompt: Beachside oyster bar in the afternoon, ceiling fans turning, a cheerful crowd, ice rattling in plastic cups, waves in the distance

biker.prompt: Desert roadhouse at sunset, a row of big V-twin motorcycles idling, one revs and rides off down the highway, desert wind, muffled rock music from inside the bar

sp4.prompt: Downtown street at one in the morning, a distant siren, footsteps on wet pavement, a group laughing, a bar door swings open and loud music spills out, then closes

happyhour.prompt: After-work happy hour in a busy tavern, laughter, toasts, glasses clinking, a ballgame on the TV above the bar

fauna.prompt: Dive bar at night heard from a stool at the bar, the bartender pulling a draft beer, bottle caps popping, a regular talking low, a group celebrating loudly in the corner

local.prompt: Old Chicago corner tavern in winter, wind outside, a radiator clanking, low chatter, an elevated train rumbling past overhead
Wisconsin tavern, a leather dice cup shaken hard and slammed on the bar, dice rolling, friendly cheers, a polka playing faintly on a radio

abroad.prompt: A crowded Mexico City pulqueria. A small cantina band plays a lively ranchera with accordion, acoustic guitars and bass, people singing along, laughing and clinking glasses. Recorded live in the room.

A Rio de Janeiro boteco on a warm night. An informal samba circle at a sidewalk table with pandeiro, cavaquinho and acoustic guitar, friends singing and chatting, bottles clinking. Recorded live outdoors.

third.prompt: Friendly neighborhood bar full of regulars talking and laughing, pool balls breaking, a jukebox playing soft old soul music

falsedive.prompt: A slick, expensive cocktail lounge pretending to be a dive bar. Smooth, polished downtempo lounge music, a cocktail shaker rattling, polite quiet chatter. Clean, glossy and a little sterile.

protocol.prompt: Dive bar at night, an old jukebox clicking as a record is chosen, a pool table rack and break, a bartender wiping down the bar, low chatter

conservation.prompt: Empty bar at closing time, chairs being stacked on tables, a broom sweeping a wooden floor, a lone bar stool creaking, a clock ticking

closing.prompt: A last call bell rings in a bar, people say goodnight and shuffle out, the door closes, then a quiet city street at night
